why: Two cameras at the same screen speed can feel unlike (2026-10-12: "숫자는 같아도 다른 느낌을 줄수 있잖아"). A recipe names a feel by the measured values that make it (grammar_core.feel, camera_taste.kind_of); takes of one shot should differ in recipe, not only in numbers. Thresholds are first values, to be revisited against the reference's own distribution with the user.
rule: A shot is a recipe when its key conditions (the value that defines the feel) are known, every condition whose value is known holds, and at least min_known are known. A condition with 'else' uses that condition only when its own value is unknown (a reel measured from pixels has no part box). Several recipes may hold: the one with more known conditions names the shot, the rest are listed; equally many is mixed.
make_rule: A recipe with 'make' is a move the engine builds from the scene, no picture needed (studio/recipe_moves.py): 'move' is a camera move type (camera_moves_core.MOVES), 'params' its fixed values, where $subject is the shot's subject and $key the parts the shot shows at its key moment (show row held at direction.move.key_at); 'needs' what the shot must have (key: a key part other than the whole subject; key_opens: the key moment opens its subject); 'focus' what the move's framing pose frames ($subject or $key) and 'choose' the values the director chooses per shot as [low, high, default]; height_share is how tall that focus stands in the frame at the framing pose (move.focus, solved on the scene), its default 'pattern' the reference's median for the shot's role kept inside the range - the range keeps the recipe's feel, the default is used and said when none is chosen. A recipe without 'make' is built from frame pictures or by hand. Why (2026-10-22): two stills joined made the motion nobody designed; the move is chosen as a move first.

recipes.name: 파고들기
recipes.means: 카메라가 설명할 부품을 향해 파고든다: 저기를 보라
recipes.settings: timing burst_settle; look_target = the part; dwell at the part's cue

recipes.name: 스쳐가기
recipes.means: 앞을 물체가 스쳐 가며 지나간다: 속도감과 현장감
recipes.settings: low over the deck, 24 mm or wider; something between the camera and the subject

recipes.name: 맞서기
recipes.means: 카메라가 대상과 반대 방향으로 움직인다: 충돌 직전의 긴장
recipes.settings: the camera rises while the subject descends (or the reverse); short

recipes.name: 우러러보기
recipes.means: 아래에서 올려다보거나 길게 당겨 크기를 보인다: 웅장함
recipes.settings: camera low and looking up, or far with a long lens; slow build

recipes.name: 따라붙기
recipes.means: 대상은 화면에 머물고 세상이 흘러간다: 함께 가는 느낌
recipes.settings: follow near 1.0; the camera keeps pace with the subject

recipes.name: 뚫고 들어가기
recipes.means: 단면 너머 속으로 밀고 들어가 구조를 보인다: 안이 이렇게 생겼다
recipes.settings: open the shell where the narration says what is inside; carry on with `then` through the inside

recipes.name: 지켜보기
recipes.means: 카메라는 멈추고 장면 안의 변화를 지켜본다: 여기서 일어나는 일을 보라 (쉼, 설명의 무게)
recipes.settings: the camera stands still; what changes in the scene carries the shot
